verdict.rationale: USCIS states up front that online filing requires creating an online account first, both for self-filers and for representatives filing with Form G-28. However, the evidence does not show any published, pre-flow list of the credential or identity-proofing steps (e.g., verification method, MFA, ID checks) a filer must clear. Missing for 10: documented credential requirements, documented identity-proofing steps, a single up-front checklist of all gates before filing, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, the service publishes exactly which account, credential, and identity-proofing steps stand between me and filing — stated before I start, not discovered mid-flow

citations.quote: Create a free online account first to file your application and start exploring all of our online services and tools.
To file a form online on behalf of your client, along with Form G-28, you must first create a USCIS online account.
You can create and access your USCIS online account from your computer, phone, or tablet.
